title: Apple Silicon A19 Pro Camera ISP Driver Dispatch & UserClient Specification

primary_classes.role: Top-level IOKit driver matching DeviceTree /arm-io/isp node
Core ISP controller driver, power governor, and channel arbitrator
User-space client gateway for camera capture daemons
Specialized user client for Pearl FaceID NIR sensor ingest
Kernel frame stream engine managing DART buffer queues
Pre-mapped DMA memory surface pool for zero-copy frame ingest

external_method_dispatch_table.name: ISP_OpenSession
external_method_dispatch_table.description: Initializes camera session and acquires channel lease

external_method_dispatch_table.name: ISP_CloseSession
external_method_dispatch_table.description: Releases channel lease and tears down session resources

external_method_dispatch_table.name: ISP_RegisterFrameReceiverQueue
external_method_dispatch_table.description: Sets up IOSharedDataQueue memory mapping for event delivery

external_method_dispatch_table.name: ISP_ConfigureStreamingChannel
external_method_dispatch_table.description: Applies CISP channel parameters, format, and sensor clock dividers

external_method_dispatch_table.name: ISP_StartChannel
external_method_dispatch_table.description: Starts DMA frame streaming from MIPI CSI-2 receiver

external_method_dispatch_table.name: ISP_StopChannel
external_method_dispatch_table.description: Halts DMA frame streaming and drains pending buffer queues

external_method_dispatch_table.name: ISP_ReturnBuffer
external_method_dispatch_table.description: Returns processed IOSurface back to the kernel/firmware pool

function_isp_map_iobmd.description: Maps an I/O Buffer Memory Descriptor into the DART-ISP IOMMU page table window

function_isp_unmap_iobmd.signature: void ispUnmapIobmd(IOService* provider, uint64_t dva, uint32_t stream_id)
function_isp_unmap_iobmd.description: Unmaps and invalidates DART-ISP TLB entries associated with the DVA
